title: Shenzhen's Sweet Secret: Exploring the Nanshan Lychee
description: Mingxi Ouyang introduced Nanshan lychee, a prized fruit from Shenzhen’s Nanshan District. Known for its juicy sweetness, rich vitamin C, and Tang Dynasty roots, this summer delicacy thrives in local climates. Learn about its harvest, cultural festivals, and global appeal. Taste the heritage of Southern China’s iconic fruit!
